services.name: Falcon Bowl
services.desc: The tried-and-true crew behind the bar at Falcon Bowl. This role includes serving alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, running transactions through our TouchBistro POS, and keeping bar areas stocked and clean during regular service and events. Folks with a friendly attitude who can roll with everything from slow weekday afternoons to packed league nights and events tend to thrive here. Our bowling alley attendants support both the lanes and the bar, helping keep everything running smoothly during regular hours and events. services.name: private event
services.desc: Falcon Bowl is closed to the public today for a private event. From weddings, receptions, fundraisers, and company parties to birthdays, reunions, release shows, and full-on “we rented a bowling alley” situations, the whole building is available for a proper takeover. Private events can use the bowling alley, main bar, Falcon Hall, the Falcon Nest, and patio, with room to keep things low-key or make a whole night out of it. Whether you need a few lanes and drinks, a private hangout space, a dance floor, a stage, or the entire damn building, we can help make it happen. Interested in hosting something here?
